name: arithmetic_subtraction
description: A dataset measuring models' ability to perform numeric subtraction problems presented as textual prompts. The benchmark evaluates whether a model can output the exact numeric result for subtraction tasks across varying operand sizes and formats. It focuses on precise arithmetic correctness rather than explanation or reasoning traces.
evaluation_method: exact_match (answer must exactly match the correct numeric result)
reputation: Part of the MIB-bench suite; used in numeric-reasoning evaluations but has limited visibility outside focused arithmetic benchmark comparisons.
